rationale: The agent found that plate/run date is confounded with case status: 54 of 60 cases were on plates 1–2 versus 8 of 60 controls, and a plate-only model reached AUROC 0.887. It also showed the signal disappears within plate groups and recommended randomizing across plates or validating on an independent cohort, which matches the key. It mentioned feature selection outside CV, but the key already covers that, so it doesn't count as an extra issue.
